fields.name: photo
fields.description: The static profile photo. Profile photos can't be reused and can only be uploaded as a new file, so you can pass “attach://<file\_attach\_name>” if the photo was uploaded using multipart/form-data under <file\_attach\_name>. [More information on Sending Files »](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sending-files)
